title: Aquarium Boka – Exploring Adriatic Marine Biodiversity
excerpt: A promotional video presenting Aquarium Boka and the EXChAngE project’s contribution to marine biodiversity awareness and sustainable cross-border tourism.
body:
Discover Aquarium Boka in Kotor through a promotional video presenting it as one of the visitor attractions enhanced through the EU co-funded EXChAngE project—Explore Cross-border Aquatic Biodiversity.

At the Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro, project investments supported interior renovation, two new aquarium tanks, improved water conditioning and an open-air exhibition. These improvements strengthened Aquarium Boka’s capacity to introduce visitors to Adriatic marine biodiversity and the importance of its conservation.

Through the Blue Pass tourism product, EXChAngE connected Aquarium Boka with aquatic biodiversity and cultural heritage attractions in Dubrovnik, Hutovo Blato and Mostar, supporting a shared cross-border tourism offer.

As Project Manager for the Institute of Marine Biology from February 2021 to August 2022, I supported project implementation, procurement documentation and reporting.
